metric_depth_fit.model: get_real_depth_map: z = near / (1 - d_norm (1 - near/far)), near = znear*extent, far = zfar*extent; znear = 0.001 from robosuite base.xml, zfar = 50 (MuJoCo default); only the extent is fitted (L1)
metric_depth_fit.why_not_gating: the card's Phase D criterion is the projected centroid agreement; this depth check was added by the implementation, and its all-pixel RMS is dominated by silhouette-edge pixels (a pixel assigned to the top face by the ray-cast but rendered as side/background)
